## Purpose

Describe the problem, decision, or reproducibility issue addressed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Method or equation
- [ ] Code
- [ ] Schema or protocol
- [ ] Evidence or data adapter
- [ ] Paper or documentation
- [ ] Security or dependency maintenance

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] Observed, inferred, assumed, and controlled values are labelled.
- [ ] No future information leaks into a hindcast.
- [ ] Third-party provenance and license terms are recorded.
- [ ] Generated outputs were regenerated, not edited manually.
- [ ] Tests and `make verify` pass.
- [ ] Commit(s) include DCO sign-off.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, confidential information, or unsupported certainty claims are included.

## Methodological effect and limitations

Explain affected variables, scenarios, outputs, compatibility, and known failure modes.
